integrity: The general all-parameter conclusion follows from a quotient-voltage proof and the BEST/matrix-tree enumeration; finite exact scripts are supporting reproducibility checks, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Classical ordinary full de Bruijn cycles; nonidentity symbolwise alphabet permutations; cycles identified only under rotation. No assertion regarding pseudo, unoriented, partial, or antimorphic cycles. The special binary case has prior self-dual-sequence literature. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains unconfirmed.
title: Alphabet-relabeling rigidity and exact symmetry counts for de Bruijn cycles
